Assume that the only interaction between $e^+$ and $e^-$ is electrostatic (both particles have the same mass $m$ and equal magnitude of the charge but of opposite sign). turns.question: A body of constant heat capacity C_c is cooled continuously by Carnot cycles while power P into the refrigerator and hot-reservoir temperature T_h stay constant. In each cycle dQ_c/dQ_h=T_c/T_h and the body cools by dT_c. Starting at T_c=T_0 at t=0, find the operating time to reach T<T_0 in terms of C_c,T_h,P,T_0,T.
turns.question_staticized: A body of constant heat capacity C_c is cooled continuously by Carnot cycles while power P into the refrigerator and hot-reservoir temperature T_h stay constant. In each cycle dQ_c/dQ_h=T_c/T_h and the body cools by dT_c. Starting at T_c=T_0 at t=0, find the operating time to reach T<T_0 in terms of C_c,T_h,P,T_0,T.
turns.official_solution: Use dQ_h=dW+dQ_c, dW=P dt, dQ_c=-C_c dT_c and dQ_h/dQ_c=T_h/T_c. Separate variables and integrate T_c from T_0 to T.

official_rubric.accepted_equivalents: Accept t=(C_c/P)[T_h ln(T_0/T)-(T_0-T)] and algebraically equivalent forms.

criteria.description: Use dQ_h=dW+dQ_c with dW=P dt and dQ_c=-C_c dT_c, together with dQ_h/dQ_c=T_h/T_c.
Separate variables to an equivalent dt=-(C_c T_h/P)(dT_c/T_c-dT_c/T_h).
Integrate from T_0 to T and obtain t=(C_c T_h/P)[ln(T_0/T)-(T_0-T)/T_h].

official_rubric.error_carry_forward: Carry a consistently stated heat/work sign convention through separation and integration for method credit; the final physical time must be positive for T<T_0.
official_rubric.source_error_handling: No source correction required.

turns.label: t3_c5
turns.question: For all cycles in T3-C4 through time t, determine the overall coefficient of performance COP=Q_c/W in terms of T_0,T_h,T.
turns.question_staticized:
For all cycles in T3-C4 through time t, determine the overall coefficient of performance COP=Q_c/W in terms of T_0,T_h,T.

<<<FROZEN GEMINI QUESTION-ONLY VISUAL ADDENDUM>>>
The preceding subpart printed immediately above defines the referenced continuous-cooling process. A body of constant heat capacity $C_c$ is cooled by successive Carnot cycles while the power $P$ transferred to the refrigerator remains constant. The hot-reservoir temperature $T_h$ is constant. In each cycle the cold-body temperature $T_c$ decreases by $dT_c$, and the heat transfers satisfy
$$\frac{dQ_c}{dQ_h}=\frac{T_c}{T_h}.$$
At $t=0$, $T_c=T_0$, and the process continues until the body reaches $T<T_0$.
<<<END FROZEN GEMINI QUESTION-ONLY VISUAL ADDENDUM>>>
turns.official_solution: The total cold heat is Q_c=C_c(T_0-T). With W=Pt and the T3-C4 time, W=C_c T_h ln(T_0/T)-Q_c; take Q_c/W.

official_rubric.accepted_equivalents: Accept COP=(T_0-T)/[T_h ln(T_0/T)-(T_0-T)] or any algebraically equivalent expression.

criteria.description: Identify total Q_c=C_c(T_0-T) and W=Pt.
Use the T3-C4 result to obtain W=C_c T_h ln(T_0/T)-Q_c.
Obtain COP=[T_h ln(T_0/T)/(T_0-T)-1]^-1.

official_rubric.error_carry_forward: Use a candidate's T3-C4 time consistently for W=Pt and award downstream ratio algebra; exact final-reference credit requires the correct time expression.
official_rubric.source_error_handling: No source correction required.
